brief.use: in-match background loop, under the play and the crowd, not over it
brief.game: Fuzeball: 3D table football for an intergalactic Federation; blue + Federation gold
brief.references: pulsing synth ostinato, big hall and dotted-delay throws, taiko and brass swells, cinematic space sport
brief.notes: Bb minor = the key opposite E on the circle of fifths (a tritone away), so it is the complement of the E menu tracks. 32 bars: A(8) B(8) C(8) A'(8), loop = whole file. Humanized quantize: 75% grid, 8% swing, +-6 ms, +-5 velocity, seeded. Target -18 LUFS.
